lines.1: Otome was probably at the dojo.
lines.2: 「You're not putting enough spirit into it! Louder! Let me hear you!」
lines.3: Her clear, commanding voice rang out from inside.
lines.4: 「That's it! Keep your toes together when you kick!」
lines.5: Whoa, the energy in here was incredible!
lines.6: Under Otome's instruction, the club members were working themselves to the bone.
lines.7: 「What is it, Tsushima? What business do you have in this sacred dojo?」
lines.9: This guy was wearing gym clothes in the dojo... Couldn't he afford a uniform?
lines.10: Maybe supporting twelve little sisters had left him broke.
lines.11: 「You've come at a troublesome time. She's busy putting the younger girls through the wringer.」
lines.12: 「They all listen to her. Otome really is strong, huh?」
lines.13: 「Hmph, of course. Kurogane won the national championship... Apparently she no longer competes now that she's a third-year.」
lines.14: 「I hear you're Kurogane's childhood friend, but don't let that go to your head.」
lines.15: 「What, are you jealous? Besides, aren't you in the Princess's fan club?」
lines.16: 「I like them both. I have a weakness for gallant women.」
lines.18: 「The troublesome part is that I will eventually have to choose between them.」
lines.19: 「You're even more delusional than I thought.」
lines.20: 「You certainly pick at everything I say, despite groveling whenever Kurogane is around.」
lines.21: 「She and the Princess are special cases.」
lines.24: 「Sh-she merely attached herself to me. It's not that I dislike her, though.」
lines.25: 「I've spent my life caring for twelve little sisters. I must radiate a certain dependable aura. How troublesome.」
lines.26: 「Twelve little sisters... You really do have it rough.」
lines.27: 「Would you like an introduction? They have very distinctive faces.」
lines.28: 「No, thank you. I must sincerely decline.」
lines.29: 「Why did you suddenly become so formal?」
lines.31: 「Hey, I'm their brother! I could never introduce my own flesh and blood to someone like him.」
lines.33: 「Wrong! A roundhouse kick pivots at the kneecap and follows an arc! Like this!」
lines.34: When Otome demonstrated the kick, I heard a whoosh as it cut through the air.
lines.36: 「Kurogane has a rich variety of kicks. Her rib-breaker, reserved for finishing blows, is incredible.」
lines.37: 「Even after the fight is over, she flips them onto their backs and stamps their ribs apart.」
lines.39: 「It's a rough technique she used one after another against delinquents near our training camp. It's only for street fights.」
lines.40: 「...I'll do my best not to make her angry.」
lines.42: 「...Leo, you have been standing there for some time. Do you need something?」
lines.44: 「The Princess is holding a meeting at Ryugu. She wants you to stop by when you reach a good break.」
lines.46: 「...Did you sleep at your desk? Honestly, the hair at the back of your head is sticking up.」
lines.49: She quickly smoothed it down with her fingers.
lines.50: 「K-Kurogane! At the club budget meeting earlier, I brilliantly secured an increase for the martial arts club!」
lines.51: 「Oh, did you? Well done. You should be proud.」
lines.52: 「Wait, Leo. One of your shirt buttons is undone.」
lines.53: 「You really do need constant looking after.」
lines.54: Being clumsy with her hands, Otome slowly fastened the button for me.
lines.56: 「Tell her I will be there in about twenty minutes.」
lines.57: 「Tsushima, don't think this means you've won!」
lines.58: 「What are you getting so worked up about?」
